diagnosis.classification: Insufficient fixture phase synchronization; no product lifecycle defect established.
diagnosis.confirmedFixtureGap: The original fixture immediately returned the same capacity message for every selected-model defaults request. Waiting for that message did not establish that the final model/provider/effort request, rather than a model-only generation, had failed.
productionContract: Workspace debounces options for 400 ms; each resource key includes the debounced options and the runtime/project epoch.
useResource immediately treats a new request key as loading without prior data/error; old generations cannot publish after cleanup.
The retry handler synchronously marks its retry state and refreshes the resource; the button is disabled while loading. The reset effect clears retry state on completion.
Composer also treats non-debounced vs debounced options mismatch as loading and preserves runtime unknown/readiness admission.
diagnosis.readScope: Complete defaults test and useResource hook; App mounting plus Workspace defaults creation/debounce/retry/send admission and ModelPicker/Composer related consumers. This is a focused lifecycle diagnosis, not a new whole-source audit.

details: Hold selected-model response promises and retain their exact request parameters.
Establish the model-only failure first, then change effort and observe the exact final high-effort request while its response remains held.
Verify the new generation detaches the old retry button, clears the previous error and disables send, then explicitly release the final generation failure before retry.

Keep the immediate busy-button/disabled-double-click assertions, exact two retry requests, no catalog refresh or write, draft/options preservation, retry failure/success and unknown-runtime send gate.
No sleep, arbitrary delay, increased timeout, assertion deletion or production change.
